## Pay Setup

How the books pay one employee, linked to their HR `Employee` card: salary or hourly rate, pay schedule, the expense account and class wages post to, filing status and allowances, and recurring deductions with the liability each is owed onward on. A salary left empty reads the HR card's salary.

```ts
import { PaySetup } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/accounting/ledger-payroll';
```
